lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy8Mg4Cd4 (reduced formula Dy2MgCd) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Dy centers with 14 geometric neighbors (10 Dy, 2 Cd, 2 Mg), while Cd and Mg each have 11 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cd and Mg 11-vertex polyhedra, corner- and face-sharing between Cd 11-vertex and Dy 14-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Dy 14-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
